# GitHub Actions Workflows

This directory contains all GitHub Actions workflow files for the SDLC Pipeline project.

## Workflows

- `sdlc-pipeline.yml` (to be created) - Main pipeline execution workflow
- `ci-cd.yml` (to be created) - Continuous integration and deployment

## Adding Workflows

When creating new workflow files:
1. Use `.yml` or `.yaml` extension
2. Place them in this directory
3. Document their purpose in this README
4. Reference them in the main project documentation
